finding.rationale: Enumeration of inbox message rules surfaces the forwardTo / forwardAsAttachmentTo / redirectTo actions that constitute auto-forwarding collection-and-exfiltration plumbing. A Conditional Access policy requiring a compliant/managed app or device for Exchange Online blocks the borrowed first-party FOCI client (14d82eec) from the mailbox-rules surface; paired with the Exchange Online outbound anti-spam policy that disables automatic external forwarding, this closes both the discovery and the exfiltration path. Recommended-but-not-yet-observed: shares Tool 13's implementation with T1114.002, which has no committed run yet.
